vat_rates.legal_product_description: Standard rate of Imposto sobre o Valor Acrescentado (IVA) on the supply of goods and services, and on the importation of goods.
vat_rates.normalized_product_description: standard rate of value-added tax on the supply of goods and services and on imports.
vat_rates.legal_reference: Regulamento do IVA (Lei nº 21/VI/2003), Artigo 17º (Taxa do imposto): « A taxa do imposto é de 15%. »

vat_zero_rated.legal_product_description: Transmissões de bens expedidos ou transportados com destino ao estrangeiro (exports of goods dispatched or transported abroad)
vat_zero_rated.normalized_product_description: exports of goods dispatched or transported abroad
vat_zero_rated.legal_reference: Regulamento do IVA (Lei nº 21/VI/2003), Artigo 13º-1(a) e (b): isenção com direito a dedução (exemption with right to deduction, i.e. zero-rating) para exportações.
